title: Spicy Chinese Omelette
description: A fast and easy Chinese-inspired breakfast dish made with eggs and spicy ingredients.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a small non-stick pan.
Add the scrambled eggs to the pan and cook until almost set.
Transfer the eggs to a plate.
Heat the remaining sesame oil in the pan, then add the soy sauce and scallions.
Return the eggs to the pan and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the spicy to taste, if using.
